failure_interpretation: a failed method falsifies this mechanism, not the broader Actions-as-Coordinates claim
heldout_policy: select method by development score, then open held-out once
hypothesis: A counterfactual action-prefix dataset is sufficient to identify causal latent control effects.
split: episode-disjoint train/development/heldout; target support built from train only
success_gate: selected method must Pareto-improve R8 on arrival, continuity, hidden path error, and support, or pass the family-specific stage gate
